data.standardized_narrative: At 1 January 2016 gross claims outstanding were GBP 612.8m. During 2016 the Syndicate recorded releases from prior accident years of GBP 40.3m (reported in the accounts as a net release), driven by favourable claims development and reserve run-off. The release contributed to the Syndicate's net technical result for the year. No gross prior-year movement figure was explicit in the movement tables, so the available net release amount has been used.

data.data_quality_notes: Opening gross claims outstanding taken from Balance Sheet liabilities (Claims outstanding, prior-year comparative column). Prior year development amount used is the explicitly stated net release of GBP 40.3m because no explicit gross prior-year movement figure was presented in the movement note; therefore prior_year_development_gbp_m is NET of reinsurance. Gross premium mix amounts were calculated from reported percentage splits (regulatory class table) applied to total gross written premiums; those amounts are derived (rounded) rather than explicitly stated. Some LOB mappings for named events are inferred from event descriptions where the report did not specify exact lines.
